Copy paste from Danny:

https://github.com/djrtwo/pycli

You can try to pull it down if you want.
Note that due to some current battle I’m having with the cli builder, the —pre and —post args must be run after the base pycli.py and cannot be after the trailing commands (eg transition, blocks, etc)

GOOD: python pycli.py —pre <sample.ssz> transition blocks … 

BAD: python pycli.py transition —pre <sample.ssz> blocks …
